name: Read Aloud: AI Voices
author: LastAi
description: Optional add-on for Read Aloud: natural AI voices (Kitten TTS, F5-TTS, Chatterbox) through a companion app that runs next to the game. Run companion/start.cmd (Windows) or companion/start.sh (Linux, macOS) once to set it up; after that the game starts it by itself. Has its own page in LunaLib's mod settings. Safe to add to or remove from a save.
